title: Free Decompression with Algebraic Spectral Curves
abstract: arXiv:2605.03634v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tools from random matrix theory have become central to deep learning theory, using spectral information to provide mechanisms for modeling generalization, robustness, scaling, and failure modes. While often capable of modeling empirical behavior, practical computations are limited by matrix size, often imposing a restriction to models that are too small to be realistic. This motivates the inference of properties of larger models from the behavior of smaller ones. Free decompression (FD) is a recently proposed method for extrapolating spectral information across matrix sizes, but its utility is currently limited by strong assumptions that preclude its implementation on more realistic machine learning (ML) models. We use algebraic spectral curve theory to provide a general FD methodology for spectral densities whose Stieltjes transform satisfies an algebraic relation, a modeling assumption that is more likely to hold in practice.

translated_title: 基于代数谱曲线的自由解压缩
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.03634v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：来自随机矩阵理论的工具已成为深度学习理论的核心，它们利用谱信息为泛化、鲁棒性、缩放和失效模式等建模提供机制。尽管这些工具通常能够刻画经验行为，但实际计算受矩阵规模的限制，往往只能局限于过小而不具现实性的模型。这促使人们从较小模型的行为来推断较大模型的性质。自由解压缩（FD）是最近提出的一种跨矩阵规模外推谱信息的方法，但其效用目前受到强假设的约束，这些假设使其无法应用于更现实的机器学习（ML）模型。我们利用代数谱曲线理论，为Stieltjes变换满足代数关系的谱密度提供了一种通用的自由解压缩方法学——这一建模假设在实践中更有可能成立。
tldr: 本文利用代数谱曲线理论，为Stieltjes变换满足代数关系的谱密度建立了更通用的自由解压缩方法，放宽了原有方法的强假设，使跨矩阵规模的谱信息外推能够应用于更现实的机器学习模型。
en_tdlr: This paper uses algebraic spectral curve theory to provide a general free decompression methodology for spectral densities whose Stieltjes transform satisfies an algebraic relation, relaxing the strong assumptions of prior work and enabling spectral extrapolation across matrix sizes for more realistic ML models.
